truth_set.verified_source: millat-2025.pdf unconsolidated primary statements (P&L p110, BS p108, CF p112), read directly
structural_observations: Millat is four separate per-year reports (no Lucky-style six-year summary).
Standalone balance sheet has NO explicit total-liabilities line AND NO unlabeled subtotal before TOTAL EQUITY AND LIABILITIES (-> total_liabilities = SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT).
Same OCF ambiguity as Lucky: 'Cash generated from operations' vs 'Net cash flows generated from operating activities'.
Millat 2025 is restated; FY ends June 30; consolidated statements also present (NCI).

blockers.detail: No Millat bbox extraction tables exist. The V2 pipeline (ocr_v2_lucky_run / table_adapter) reads output/bbox_extraction_poc/tables, which contains Lucky tables only.

default bridge config is Lucky-hardcoded: page ranges 162-164 (summary/analysis), 236-283 (unconsolidated), 286-375 (consolidated), Lucky fingerprint, Lucky label aliases. No generic derivation, no Millat config. Millat statements are on different pages (unconsolidated P&L p110, BS p108, CF p112 in a 298-page report), so the Lucky config tags every Millat page UNKNOWN -> governance cannot classify -> selection collapses.

Producing a Millat bridge config (Millat page ranges/label aliases) would be required to run, but that is Millat-specific configuration which this task explicitly prohibits ('No Millat-specific heuristics / Do not add Millat-specific rules'). Therefore 'run unchanged' is unsatisfiable on Millat in the current architecture.

comparison_metrics.reason: OCR V2 produced no Millat output; there is nothing to compare against the truth set.

miss_root_cause_classification.reason: No V2 run -> no per-cell misses to classify. The program-level blocker is classified instead:

generalization_finding.explanation: OCR V2 has no issuer-general execution path. The general governance/selection CORE may generalize, but the executable pipeline is coupled to a per-issuer bridge config + staged extraction input. Lucky 66/66 is the result of a Lucky-tuned bridge config over the general core, not a demonstrated multi-issuer property.

prerequisites_to_unblock: Create Millat bbox extraction tables (camelot/pdfplumber available) for the metric-bearing pages of the 4 reports.
Create a Millat bridge config (page ranges -> basis/statement_type/entity_scope + label aliases) -- per the Millat validation plan (MISSING_MUST_CREATE).
Complete the truth set for FY2022/2023 from millat-2022.pdf / millat-2023.pdf.
Re-run: only then can the unchanged governance/selection core be tested on Millat -- and whether the SAME KIND of config generalizes is the real over-fit test.
